From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>

Subject: ACME - Post-demo follow-up: pricing & next steps

Hi Alice / Bob —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and next steps from the demo:

1) Volume & shape (your correctness please):
   - Expected steady-state: ~1.2B tokens / month (burst to ~2B).
   - Usage mix: ~75% chat/generation (prompt + completion), ~25% embeddings and occasional reranking requests.
   - Avg response length estimate we used: 180 tokens completion / 40 tokens prompt.

2) Budget & target unit economics (from call):
   - initial budget target: $15k–$25k / month
   - stated target $/1M tokens: roughly $10–$15 (you said aiming for ~$12/1M tokens)

3) What I attached:
   - ACME_Redwood_Cost_Model_v1.xlsx (breaks down hosted vs dedicated, quantization options, and per 1M token unit prices)
   - rough assumptions are highlighted on tab "assumptions" — please confirm or update.

4) Next steps I propose:
   - You: confirm the monthly token estimate (1.2B steady-state + burst profile) and any feature priorities that affect token shape (e.g., longer completions).
   - We: produce a 2-option estimate (hosted consumption pricing vs Dedicated reserved capacity + autoscale) with a one-page invoice-style estimate for procurement.
   - Marissa will prepare a dedicated capacity delta (savings at 6/12/24 month commits) and include quantization/throughput tradeoffs.

If that looks right I’ll send the formal invoice estimate and a short comparison (hosted vs reserved) by EOD Monday.

Attachments: [attachment: ACME_Redwood_Cost_Model_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Cheers,

Hi Sean —

Thanks for the recap — that matches our notes. A couple clarifications:

- Monthly breakdown: we expect ~1.2B tokens total as you used. That is mostly user-facing chat (avg length may creep to ~220 tokens in Q4 as we roll out a longer-context assistant) — please include a sensitivity to +20% avg completion length.
- Embeddings: roughly 250M tokens / month for batch embeddings (monthly job), so that should be modeled separately from chat.
- Budget: we’re targeting $15k–$25k/mo initially, with runway to increase if we see strong unit economics or clear latency improvements. Procurement is ready to review a one-page estimate + SOW; preferred format is PDF + a simple CSV with line-item assumptions.

If you can send the hosted vs dedicated comparison + a short invoice-style PDF, procurement will review next week.

Thanks — Alice

Sean —

I started the two-option model you requested. Notes/asks:

- Assumptions used in ACME_CostOptions_20261011.csv: 1.2B tokens/mo baseline, 20% burst headroom, embeddings separated at 250M tokens.
- Hosted (consumption): we modeled two unit-price tiers:
   * Standard (no quantization): $14 / 1M tokens (baseline latency / highest quality)
   * Quantized (FP16/INT4 mixed approach): $10 / 1M tokens (est. quality delta small for embeddings, slight regen risk for long completions)
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): modeled as committed GPUs + rps target. Effective $/1M tokens depends on utilization — at 70–80% utilization we show $7–9 / 1M tokens (6 or 12 month commit).
- Included quick sensitivity tab: +20% avg completion length and +30% monthly volume.

I attached the CSV export with the options and a short assumptions section. I can also export to a simple line-item CSV for procurement to ingest.

Attachments: [attachment: ACME_CostOptions_20261011.csv (csv, cost options)]

Let me know if you want me to produce a single-page PDF invoice estimate or if you want to review first.

-Marissa

Hi Alice / Bob / Procurement —

Per our thread and Marissa’s model, attached is a one-page invoice-style estimate and the supporting cost model CSV. High level callouts:

- Hosted consumption estimate (baseline): ~$13.2 / 1M tokens (blended across chat + embeddings given your current mix) -> est $16,000 / month at 1.2B tokens (sensitivity table in the PDF).
- Dedicated reserved capacity (12-month commit): effective $/1M tokens range $7–9 at 70–80% utilization -> est $9,500 / month run-rate at our conservative utilization assumptions.
- Recommendation: if you expect >60% utilization and want predictable unit cost, Dedicated with a 12-month commit looks attractive; otherwise start Hosted and evaluate after 3 months.

Attached:
 - ACME_Invoice_Estimate_20261012.pdf (one-page invoice-style estimate for procurement)

 - ACME_CostOptions_20261011.csv (export of modeled price options)
